note: vespera_core fixes: a Reference Object ($ref) in a Header or Example position is rejected instead of silently deserializing as an empty object; a merged path item that adopts the incoming unresolvable $ref takes the incoming path-level parameters / servers instead of keeping the receiver's; a non-finite numeric constraint (minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, multipleOf) is a serialize error instead of null; a bad Paths / Responses / Callback entry names its key in the error. Docs: the streaming chunk buffer lease discards its cached slot on panic.
